

SLOT gestureSlots INSERT TEMPLATE swipes{
	id: swipeForPenSwap
	distance: 0.5 
	direction:Qt.point(0, -1) 
	conditionName:  eraseOr
	releaseRequired: false
	condition: (toolbar.selectedTool === toolbar.primaryPen || toolbar.selectedTool === toolbar.secondPen)
	areas: Qt.rect(0, 0.9*touchArea.height, touchArea.width/2, 0.1*touchArea.height)
	fingers:2
	action:{
	toolbar.swapEraser();
        }
}
END SLOT
